_comment: String literals that legitimately contain CJK but are NOT user-visible i18n violations. Each entry is matched by exact literal text. Add new entries only with a one-line justification in the matching PR description.

_categories.lookupKey: Matches a backend-provided category/enum value used as an object key for icon/color lookups. Translating would break the lookup unless the backend value changes too.
_categories.nativeLanguageName: A language's own name shown in its own script inside a language switcher (i18n convention: language names are not translated).
_categories.testFixture: Test-only fixture data (setupTests.js, *.test.*) that never renders in the real app.
